questions.text: What is the importance of microprocessor in microprocessor-based computer system? How does a microprocessor differ with a microcontroller?
Draw and discuss the organization of 8088 microprocessor system design.
Write down the specific use of general purpose registers and control flags.
Explain why the system with multi-core processor is better than the system with single core processor?
How many cores are available in the following processor family? (i) Core i3 (ii) Core i5 (iii) Core i7
Draw and describe the system block diagram of Microprocessor system design.
questions.uncertain: Topic: could equally be Microprocessor Fundamentals.

questions.text: Find the unknowns value for each of the following physical addresses. Assume all numbers are hexadecimal numbers. (i) 6765 : ? = DABC0 (ii) ? : CD21 = 32D21
What are the differences between CISC and RISC? Write down the instruction codes both for RISC and CISC processor of the statement a[i] = a[i]+b[i]:
What are the advantages of pipelining in the process of instruction execution by a microprocessor? Discuss briefly the pipelining process.
Discuss about the components of a microprocessor with necessary diagram.
How can the overhead to access memory by processor be reduced? Discuss briefly about such kind device and its process with necessary diagram if exist.
questions.uncertain: Marks read as 05; a pen mark sits on the digit.

questions.text: Suppose AL contains 11001010b. Give the new contents of AL and CF after each of the following instruction is executed. (i) ROL Al, CL where CL contains 2 (ii) ROR AL, CL where CL contains 2
Which components of a microprocessor need to be redesigned to speed up the processing speed? Write your opinion.
As larger size RAM is better for good performance but still why we can't install any larger size RAM as we want? Answer briefly.
Distinguish between memory mapped I/O and Isolated I/O.
What is the mode and I/O configuration A, B and C of an 8255 PPI chip after it's control register loaded with 82H.
Write an assembly code to calculate the factorial of a given number.
Why DMA mode is faster than the instruction mode?
Write down a sequence of instructions to perform following problem. Put the sum 100+95+90+....+5 in AX.
Write assembly code for each of the following decision structure. (i) IF AL<0 THEN Put FFh in AH ELSE Put 0 in AH END_IF (ii) IF (AX<BX) OR (BX<CX) THEN Put 0 in DX ELSE Put 1 in DX END_IF
Suppose DX register contains a number which may be positive or negative. Now write down the ways to reverse the sign of the number only.
What is the basic difference between AND and TEST instructions?
Write down an assembly program which will take a single digit as input and will calculate the sum of all one bits of its ASCII value.
Write a procedure to take a string up to new line and another procedure to reversely display the string using stack. The two procedures will then be called by main procedure.
What are the restrictions on MOV and XCHG instructions in assembly language?
Discuss what happens when the PC is powered up.
Briefly describe how an assembly instruction is executed?
How a 20-bit physical address for 8086 is handled by 16-bit register.
Describe the function of each status flag in 8086 microprocessor.
